ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobe areas consist of large contiguous white fields; dense black mottling is concentrated along the leading margins and entire trailing edge; a distinct dark vertical line is visible at the upper mid-section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 85 degrees and a depth-to-lobe-height ratio of roughly 1:5.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations (1-4 pixel amplitude) along both lobes; the distal right tip exhibits extreme high-amplitude irregularity due to a textured protrusion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curves transitioning into sharp, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, dark-textured pixel cluster at the distal right lobe tip; small, discrete dark circular focal points scattered on the medial white region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark diagonal linear disruption on the upper right lobe; multiple faint, parallel grey linear markings on the white surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant dark, irregular mass/protrusion is located at the apex of the right fluke tip, altering the standard smooth geometric curve.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark, symmetrical 'V' shaped pigmentation pattern at the junction of the peduncle and the fluke notch.
